semantics.required_first_argument: string1 is required and may be explicitly empty; a missing value raises the existing built-in argument error.
semantics.second_argument: string2 defaults to the empty string; omitted middle arguments are retained by the call frame.
semantics.omitted_pad: Combine through the shorter operand and copy the longer operand's unmatched tail unchanged.
semantics.explicit_pad: Must contain exactly one byte; values 00 through FF extend the shorter operand on the right before applying the operation.
semantics.result: Binary-safe length-bearing string; result length is the longer operand length.
semantics.numeric_values: Existing REXX argument string conversion is used; raw byte strings are not rounded or processed through NUMERIC DIGITS.
semantics.implementation: Three BIFs share one internal bytewise helper and the existing result allocator; input buffers are preserved and output owns its allocation.

hosted.allocation_failure_injection: PASS — each BIF returned out-of-memory without publishing a result, preserved inputs, recovered on the next call, and left no live allocator blocks.
hosted.property_method: Independent bytewise oracle over unequal-length and padded cases; equal-length identities, commutativity, and De Morgan relationships checked with the fixed seed and hand-built boundary vectors.
